hook.name: PhiEthHooks
hook.description: A custom-curve hook that implements 1:1 swaps between ETH and phiETH (a 1:1 ETH wrapper token). In beforeSwap, it intercepts swaps by taking input from the PoolManager, calling phiEth.deposit or phiEth.withdraw for conversion, and settling the output — bypassing concentrated liquidity entirely. Liquidity addition to the pool is permanently blocked.
